messages:
nora: dropped a tiny mock for the trace header actions. main Q: should download be an explicit primary or stay in kebab? figma: https://redwood.test/figma/trace-cta
ben: for incident flow, Download is top task. put it inline. copy and open are also common.
mira: proposed primary order: [Copy correlation ID] [Open trace] [Download trace] then kebab for annotate/pin/share.
jess: accessibility checks: 1) toolbar role + aria-label="Trace actions"; 2) icon-only buttons need aria-labels and 44x44 hit area; 3) announce start/finish of download via aria-live.
ben: implementation note: download kicks off async job; show a non-modal toast with a progress link and a persistent "Download ready" chip in header for 24h.
mira: copy nits: use explicit labels: "Copy correlation ID" and "Open trace in new tab". for mobile collapse to icons-only but keep aria-labels.
jess: keyboard shortcuts: C=copy, O=open, D=download. add hint in keyboard help and in tooltip. ensure tab order matches visual order.
devbot: automated a11y scan: hover contrast for icon-only state 2.6:1 (fail). recommend focus ring with 4.5:1 contrast.
ben: also: when copying truncated ids visually, copy full id. add aria-describedby message "Full correlation ID copied" on success.
mira: action items: 1) design to update mock with download primary + 44px targets (mira). 2) eng to add aria-live for download flow + persistent chip (ben). 3) a11y to re-scan after changes (jess). will post updated frames by EOD. :thumbsup:
